meta.purpose: Subscribe to sensor MQTT, batch one processing cycle, invoke the Data Collection Agent service entrypoint (T1001). GLUE ONLY — contains NO validation logic (Constitution III: modularity; n8n moves data, the Python service decides). [DB/MQTT live verification deferred — no broker locally.]
meta.invokes: src/agents/data_collection/service.py :: run_cycle (exposed over HTTP by T1001 deployment)
meta.validation_logic: none — all liveness/range/spike/gap/pending/late-arrival/clock-drift/dedup logic lives in the Python service, never here

nodes.name: MQTT Trigger (Mosquitto)
nodes.notes: Subscribe to the sensor topic. One message = one raw reading payload. No parsing/validation here — the raw JSON is forwarded as-is.

nodes.name: Batch Per Cycle
nodes.notes: Collect messages arriving within one processing window into a single batch array. Time-window batching only — no inspection of payload contents.

nodes.name: Invoke Data Collection Agent (T1001)
nodes.notes: POST the batch to the Python service entrypoint. Retries the TRIGGER/invoke up to 3x on transport failure (Constitution IV: reliability). The service returns a structured CycleSummary; n8n does not interpret it beyond logging.

nodes.name: Cycle OK?
nodes.notes: Branch on the service's structured ok flag only — NOT on any per-sensor verdict. Routing/alerting on verdicts is downstream, out of scope for this glue workflow.

parameters.content: Cycle failed at the service boundary (ok=false). Log + alert ops. The malformed/error detail is in {{ $json.error }}. No retry here — the HTTP node already retried transport; an ok=false is a structured result, not a transport fault.
Cycle accepted. Verdicts are already persisted by the service (validated_readings + sensor_status + decision_log). Nothing further for n8n to do.
